statement: SDL 3.2.0's Linux evdev backend contains a Microsoft-vendor-only automatic mapping for the four Elite paddle key capabilities, associating BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY5 through BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY8 with right and left paddle slots when all four keys are advertised. This conditional mapping path does not alone prove which mapping the SDL Gamepad API selects at runtime.

applicability.scope: SDL_sysjoystick.c:2655-2675. The evdev BTN_GRIP names correspond to the trigger-happy key positions; an SDL mapping-database entry or user override can change mapping selection. Vendor identity affects the condition.
